# dsh-claude-skills — DSH bundle layer (#37)
#
# Registers the upstream alirezarezvani/claude-skills skill tree
# (pinned commit aa8d778811a557a2c28ccadda4cf3d0bd028a4cc, marketplace
# metadata v2.11.2) as a repository-provided host `skill-filesystem`
# instance in the global skill layer, so the skills load in every DSH surface.
#
# Why a dedicated instance: DSH's skill registry is layered; host rows and
# repository plugins land in the global layer and every agent reads the
# merged result. A distinct providerName avoids colliding with a preset's
# default `filesystem` provider, and `includeDefaultRoots: false` keeps this
# instance scanning ONLY this bundle's own roots (it must not re-scan
# ~/.dsh/skills or project roots).
#
# Path resolution: in a bundle patch layer, baseUrl is the PROFILE directory
# ($DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/), and `dsh plugin add` installs this package
# into <profile>/node_modules/dsh-claude-skills/, so each relative URL below
# resolves to a skills root inside the installed bundle.
#
# Root set is exhaustive: every SKILL.md in the canonical tree (362) except
# ONE fixture is reachable from a registered root (test enforces this).
#  - 86 `<domain>/skills` roots + `engineering/` (minimalist, strict-api)
#    + the package root (loop-library) = 88 roots, 361 skills.
#  - Excluded: engineering/skills/skill-tester/assets — `sample-skill` is a
#    test fixture of skill-tester (its own frontmatter name is
#    sample-text-processor), not a user-facing skill; registering it would
#    pollute the catalog.
#  - Excluded by design (cross-tool conversion trees, not canonical content):
#    .codex/skills, .gemini/skills, .hermes/skills, .vibe/skills — generated
#    copies for other coding agents; registering them would duplicate the
#    catalog.
#  - 2 skills (markdown-html/skills/design-system, md-slides) have frontmatter
#    the DSH yaml parser rejects (upstream data quirk, kept verbatim); they
#    parse-fail at discovery and warn, per dsh skill-filesystem behaviour.
- insert:
    - id: skill-filesystem-claude-skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        providerName: claude-skills
        includeDefaultRoots: false
        customSkillDirs:
          - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('node_modules/dsh-claude-skills/business-growth/skills/', baseUrl))  # 5 skills [business-growth/skills]
          - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('node_modules/dsh-claude-skills/business-operations/skills/', baseUrl))  # 7 skills [business-operations/skills]
          - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('node_modules/dsh-claude-skills/c-level-advisor/arquiteto-de-empresa/skills/', baseUrl))  # 1 skills [c-level-advisor/arquiteto-de-empresa/skills]

[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> **362 个 Claude Code 技能库，移植（port）进 DeepSeek Harness —— 工程、产品、营销、
> 合规、C-level 咨询、研究与日常生产力的开箱即用技能包。**
> 技能正文与上游 [alirezarezvani/claude-skills](https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills)
> 逐字一致，原样保留，一字未改。

- 📦 **362 个技能、88 个插件域**：工程（含 25 个 POWERFUL 进阶技能）、产品、营销
  （含 AEO 引擎优化）、监管与质量、C-level 顾问（完整 C-suite）、研究（litreview /
  grants / patent / deep-research 等）、生产力（capture / reflect / handoff /
  deep-work / meetings）、金融、商业运营与增长、Markdown→HTML 等 18 个领域。
- 🐍 **658 个 Python 工具**（规范树内 .py 文件实测；上游 marketplace 宣称 644）：绝大多数 stdlib-only；少数技能需要 pip 依赖（PyYAML、torch/onnx、PIL、requests/bs4/pandas、firecrawl，见对应技能说明）。
- 🧩 **SKILL.md 原生格式**：每个技能是 `<name>/SKILL.md` 目录包（正文 + scripts +
  references + assets），dsh 按标准发现。
- 🔒 **自带 Skill Security Auditor**：安装前扫描技能的命令注入 / 数据外送 / 提示注入。

安装后所有技能进入 dsh 的全局技能层，在任何 dsh 界面（Web / TUI / headless）都能按名调用：

```
Using the senior-architect skill, review our microservices architecture
and identify the top 3 scalability risks.
```

仓库未发布到 npm，用 GitHub 安装（git 安装可能触发 pnpm 的 build-script 白名单；
若被拦截，`dsh` 会打印要补到该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `allowBuilds`
下的确切 key，补上后重跑同一条命令即可。本包无构建步骤，多数环境不需要）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:GongYuanCaiJi/dsh-claude-skills
```

本地路径安装（先 `npm install`）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/GongYuanCaiJi/dsh-claude-skills.git
cd dsh-claude-skills && npm install
dsh plugin --profile <name> add .
```

技能按领域分目录保留（`engineering/skills/`、`marketing-skill/skills/`……），
dsh 的发现规则是单层 `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md`，因此每个领域目录都是一个注册根。
安装后直接按技能名调用即可；不知道用哪个时，让模型浏览技能目录或直接描述任务。

- 数量口径：**362** 是上游宣称的技能数（本仓库规范树里也确实有 362 份 SKILL.md）。
  本插件实际注册 **361** 个（88 个注册根，穷举覆盖，测试强制）；其中 2 个
  （`markdown-html/skills/design-system`、`md-slides`）的 frontmatter 含 dsh YAML
  解析器不接受的写法（上游数据瑕疵，逐字保留不修），dsh 会在发现时警告并跳过，
  所以**可用技能 359** 个。

Not published to npm yet — install from GitHub (git installs may hit pnpm's
build-script allowlist; if refused, `dsh` prints the exact `allowBuilds` key to
add under the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then re-run the same command.
This package has no build step, so most environments won't need it):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:GongYuanCaiJi/dsh-claude-skills
```

Local path (run `npm install` first):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/GongYuanCaiJi/dsh-claude-skills.git
cd dsh-claude-skills && npm install
dsh plugin --profile <name> add .
```

Skills keep their per-domain layout (`engineering/skills/`, `marketing-skill/skills/`, …).
DSH discovery is one level deep (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md`), so each domain
directory is a registered root. Call any skill by name after install.
